name: embedded-temporal
description: Run a Mistral Workflows / Temporal activity worker on an ESP32: register, long-poll for activity tasks over gRPC/TLS, run your handler, report the result. No cloud SDK, no host in the loop. Requires arduino-esp32 core 3.x (see README).
keywords: temporal, mistral-workflows, grpc, esp32, iot, worker, nanopb, http2
